title: Finding contract
summary: Record enough evidence for someone else to confirm and act on the issue.

sections.label: Fields
items: Affected revision, module/location, and expected invariant.
Meaningful acceptance/verification and estimated effort with uncertainty.
Duplicate-ticket check and release implications where relevant.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: The finding is actionable and reproducible or clearly states its evidential limits. The owner can distinguish a defect, missing requirement, environment problem, or audit-design issue.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
items: Recommended workflow steps: Reproduce the observed problem, Investigate the cause, Stories and delivery plan, Observe and improve. These links are recommendations based on the guide content, not required product or process choices.
A finding record names the expected invariant, observed behavior, revision and exact reproduction evidence, or states why reproduction is unavailable.
The record distinguishes confirmed cause from hypotheses and names the affected owner and exposure.
A proposed correction has a measurable acceptance check, duplicate check and dependency list. Estimated effort is labeled with uncertainty.
Existing source claims were not re-audited in this mapping pass. Project configuration, usefulness and actual check outcomes remain unverified.

catalog.applicability: Use when recording an audit or debt finding that another person must confirm and act on. It lists the fields that make a finding actionable and reproducible, or explicit about its evidential limits.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
